AllowedTargetOrigins.title: Sites where ReproDesk may be armed
AllowedTargetOrigins.description: Origin patterns (scheme://host[:port], e.g. https://*.example.com or http://localhost:*). If set, ReproDesk refuses to arm anywhere else. Empty or unset means no restriction.

BlockedOrigins.title: Sites where ReproDesk must never run
BlockedOrigins.description: Origin patterns. Wins over the allow-list. A running capture on a newly blocked site is stopped.

ApprovedOrigins.title: Extra approved origins (same Target Profile)
ApprovedOrigins.description: Plain origins such as https://sso.example.com that are added to every user's approved scope (for example SSO or payment domains).

ReplayWindowSec.title: Rolling replay window (seconds)
ReplayWindowSec.description: Fixes the Instant Replay window. The user can no longer change it.

AfkAutoPauseMinutes.title: AFK auto-pause after idle minutes (0 = off)

MarkerScreenshots.title: Take a screenshot with every marker

VideoCaptureAllowed.title: Allow video capture
VideoCaptureAllowed.description: false = video is forbidden: ReproDesk only works in Screenshot-only mode. true = not forbidden (the user's own choice stays).

EnvironmentLabel.title: Environment label shown in every report

AllowedExportFormats.title: Allowed export formats
AllowedExportFormats.description: Subset of zip, html, docx, xlsx, txt, md. Unset means all. An explicit list with no known format means none.

AllowUnredactedOriginals.title: Allow exporting unredacted original screenshots
AllowUnredactedOriginals.description: false = the 'include original screenshots' switch disappears and originals never leave the device.

RequireExportConfirmation.title: Ask the user to confirm before every export
RequireExportConfirmation.description: Shows a reminder that video and screenshots may contain sensitive visible data.

SessionRetentionDays.title: Delete finished sessions after N days (0 = keep)
